intro.summary: St Alphonsus Liguori, bishop and Doctor of the Church, founded the Redemptorists and is remembered for his moral theology and pastoral zeal.

blocks.title: Introduction

parts.text: In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. Glorious Saint Alphonsus, loving Father of the poor and sick, all your life you devoted yourself, with heroic charity, to lighten their spiritual and bodily miseries. Full of confidence in your tender pity for the sick, since you yourself patiently bore the cross of illness, I come to you for help in my present needs

I place myself under your protection, that you may always be my guide in the way of holiness and salvation. Loving father of the suffering, Saint Alphonsus, look with compassion upon me in my suffering. Ask God to give me good health of mind and body, and if not, give me great peace and joy in God’s will. I unite my sufferings to Christ, in union with His great sufferings, and with those of Our Lady, Mother of Sorrows, for the salvation of souls on earth and in Purgatory, and in thanksgiving for the remission of my many sins. Amen. Saint Alphonsus, you said that every saint became a saint through Mental Prayer. Help me learn to do Mental Prayer each day, and spend time quietly with Our Lord. Amen. Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen. Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
